== Biography ==
The index lists Karl F S Glasgow, born 1883 in New South Wales. Father: William H Glasgow. Mother: Rebecca J Glasgow. Registration place: Narrandera, New South Wales, Australia. Reference: 25126.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1778/records/2568706 Ancestry, Australia, Birth Index, 1788–1922: Karl F S Glasgow, record 1778/2568706].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The birth index names William H or William and Rebecca J Glasgow at Narrandera. The family is identified with William Henry Glasgow-851 and Rebecca Jane (Ross) Glasgow-17711, whose daughter Annie Glasgow-850 was born at Narrandera in 1888. The shared names, registration district and chronology support the link; no separate existing profile was found. The parent links are probable, not proved by a single record.
